title: SDLC project configuration
description: SDLC project configuration, stored at the root of SDLC_PM/.

version.description: Configuration schema version. '3.0' = standalone bundle (absolute paths), '3.1' = system install (~/.claude/), '3.2' = + documentation tiers + HANDOFF/RESUME, '4.0' = English rewrite + output_language.

project_name.description: Project name (slug). Letters, digits, hyphens, underscores.

output_language.description: Language (BCP 47 tag or plain name, e.g. "fr", "en", "es") in which SDLC artifacts and user-facing messages are written. Instructions, identifiers and section markers stay in English. Asked at /sdlc:init; defaults to the language the user writes in.

primary_language.description: Main programming language of the project; selects the standards loaded by the sdlc-lang-dispatcher sub-skill.

secondary_languages.description: Additional programming languages present in the project (multi-stack).

model_profile.description: Default model profile. budget=Haiku, balanced=Haiku for simple tasks/Sonnet for execution/Opus for architecture, quality=Sonnet for simple tasks/Opus elsewhere, inherit=same model as the main session.

model_overrides.description: Per-agent model overrides (key = agent name, value = model ID). E.g. {"sdlc-architect": "claude-opus-5-5"}.

auto_approve.description: Semi-autonomous mode: skips the Y/N confirmations between tasks. Code Lock and the AQ Gate stay active.

max_retry_per_task.description: Maximum attempts before a P### becomes 🚫 (blocked).

fresh_context_per_task.description: Spawns a subagent (Agent tool, fresh context) for each P###. Disable if API cost is critical.

wave_parallelism.description: Runs the P### of the same wave in parallel. Disable for sequential execution (debugging).

max_parallel_agents.description: Maximum number of subagents run at the same time within a wave.

soft_failure_escalation.description: When a P### fails, retries once with the next model tier up (Haiku→Sonnet, Sonnet→Opus).

test_coverage_min.description: Minimum test coverage required by the AQ Gate (0.7 = 70%).

code_lock_enabled.description: Enables the Code Lock rule. Disable it only for the SDLC tooling itself.

documentation_tier.description: Amount of documentation the framework produces, proportional to project size. none=one-liner (nothing), minimal=small project (HANDOFF+RESUME), standard=medium project (+0_context + light 1_elicitation + 3_conception), full=large project (complete E→A→P→T cycle + ADRs), exhaustive=colossal project (full + ASVS L2+ + hooks + archive). See references/documentation-tiers.md.

project_size_estimate.description: Initial estimate of the project size, asked at /sdlc:init. Used to suggest a default documentation_tier (one-liner→none, small→minimal, medium→standard, large→full, colossal→exhaustive). Can be changed after init.
